div.span:
Data: EfStockStore
CAS = UPDATE BookStock
SET current_quantity = @new
WHERE book_id = @id AND current_quantity = @expected

Data: EfUnitOfWork
Serializable transaction +
CreateExecutionStrategy() for retry

FinalizeAsync:
1. count.Finalize(...)
2. InventoryAdjustment.CreateForCount(difference lines)
3. CAS each line into BookStock
4. Movements from adjustment.Books

ApproveAsync does NOT call
IStockStore / Adjustment / Movement.
